style.backgroundSystem: matte misty-blue #8FA2BF and light haze-blue #D6E0F0 fields, with pure white #FFFFFF reserved for packshot and information screens

style.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent fresh aqua skincare visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of misty blue #8FA2BF, light haze blue #D6E0F0, champagne-gold product accent #C9A876 and charcoal text #33383D; bright soft studio lighting with gentle water reflections and soft contact shadows; modern geometric sans-serif; consistent thin-line droplet icon style; clean high-end skincare photography mixed with minimal infographic elements; stable slight 3/4 hero product angle and scale; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles.
style.presentationRules: stable slight 3/4 hero angle and consistent scale for the tube across the set; props never cover the product
